svg.title: A finance role: who can see money at all — SoftTrack web design mockup (#130)
svg.desc: Administration → Users gains a Finance chip and Grant/Revoke finance access. Granting asks for confirmation and writes a log line. Site admin and finance admin are separate: neither implies the other.

svg.text: is_finance_admin on the user, set only by a site admin. One dependency (lib_utils-style) guards every finance endpoint. Finance fields live in their own response schemas, never
on profile, directory or admin-directory models, so a refactor that reuses a model cannot leak a salary: it would be a type error.
